clips.title: The story
paras: Conservator Ilthalaine sends defenders into Shadowglen to thin its growing wildlife. Mature thistle boars and mangy nightsabers threaten the glade's balance.

Shadowglen's adult animals now threaten the World Tree's ecosystem. Conservator Ilthalaine sends young defenders deeper into the forest to hunt mature thistle boars and older, mangy nightsabers. Their appetites can exhaust the land's limited plants and game.

North of Aldrassil, younger cubs give way to mottled nightsabers and aggressive boars that root through the soil. For kaldorei, controlled hunting is a grim duty, but it protects the whole forest from collapse.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thinning the younger population of creatures here in Shadowglen was a good start, friend, but there is still work to be done.

The resources of the forest will be depleted too quickly if the problem is not addressed. Killing nature's beasts is a necessary evil for the good of all who share the land. Venture into the forest and slay mangy nightsabers and thistle boars in the name of balance.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your task is not yet complete, friend. Return to me once 8 mangy nightsabers and 8 thistle boars have been killed.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven your dedication to nature well, friend. A young hunter like yourself has a promising future.
